title: 天皇賞（春）の後に・3人の未来

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Taishin defeats Biwa Hayahide in the spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite her loss, Biwa Hayahide is in good spirits after witnessing Narita Taishin run so wholeheartedly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Winning Ticket is envious of the fun race that Narita Taishin and Biwa Hayahide shared…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But the Twinkle Series is not over yet, and they'll have as many chances as they want to race together again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The BNW trio promises to once again face off at the autumn Tenno Sho.
